note_en: 不只是 A，更重要的是 B means "it's not only A — more importantly, B": first a too-simple explanation is set aside, then the main point is named. In the text: 他回来不只是为了爷爷的桃子，更重要的是想试试，村里能不能留住像他这样的人 "he came back not just for his grandfather's peaches; more importantly, he wanted to see whether the village could keep people like him." The pair can even be split across lines of dialogue: "不只是卖桃子。" … "更重要的是，他们不用走了。"
